rules.rule: Failed local uploads remain retryable and may be individually removed without deleting ready attachments. Shared original upload consumers clear only the matching upload error, retaining unrelated business or unknown-command feedback.
rules.source: User authorizes all known Acceptance defects through Dot. Root real external-paper observation: rejected PLT followed by valid PNG and completed original task leaves failed no-id entry. Distinct from991. UI golden20261115 records this authorized narrow repair and existing no-data-delete boundaries.
rules.initialization: Transient hook metadata only: purpose/task owner/attempt on local File, no schema, persistence, data migration or library/attachment deletion. All four existing hook callers keep their original upload/save commands and failure retry. Removing only failed no-id entries revokes the local object URL; ready and in-flight files cannot be removed through this action.
rules.dateAndPermission: No dates, plans, costs, quantities or authorization change. Shared callback clears current string only when identical to removed upload error. Uploaded private object/reference and original write gates remain authoritative.
rules.expectation: 92unit cases pass: failed sibling survives ordinary save; explicit removal preserves ready/in-flight; completed snapshot preserves other task, purpose, later file/retry and ready reference. Real original supervisor App rejects invalidPLT, removes it with correct feedback and preserves validPNG native attachment.

rules.rule: Task completion may retire only its captured failed upload intents after a successful original command and fresh native completed task, including recovery from a known commit followed by failed reading. Rejected or uncertain writes and failed reads retain original state and body/key.
rules.source: User-authorized external-paper failed-entry repair. GitHub Review4579840297 proved file selection incorrectly set generic dirty state after explicit removal. Real native regression also proved successful receipt plus failed read left workbench dirty after recheck because completion callback was missing. Fix original completion/read recovery, not a new submission protocol or blanket clearing.
rules.initialization: Original operation ref captures exact source/upload epoch/task/purpose/attempt snapshot before first actual POST; original-key retries retain the same snapshot. Original task-bound upload inputs supply task identity. Fresh GET must confirm same task completed, not a generic200 or arbitrary sibling. Matching known commit recheck closes the original feedback phase; no extra business POST is sent by that read. Canonical risk map selects native execution/technical suites and original browser preparation.
rules.dateAndPermission: Native assignee supervisor, current original source/task/round authorization and private attachment grants remain.409 rejected, lost successful receipt, same-key replay,503read and laterGET tested distinctly. No actual time or cancellation semantics changed; old observed cancelled legacy timing/default two-clock differences remain separate bounded audit, not declared bugs or silently repaired.
rules.expectation: 65realPG16/native cases pass, including original paper/sewing acknowledged-only settlement, true unsaved guard, same-session authorization and technical history. New external-paper case proves rejected/unknown/readfail retain failures; final GET-only recheck clears captured failure and stale dirty hint while later failed file remains removable in the completed view; failed-only removal permits leaving but real note edits remain guarded; exactly one actual receipt, original ready object retained and no storage delete.
